lines.en: My plated back bears down through the woods.
Four thick legs sink and lift.

lines.zh: 背脊上挂着干枯的海藻
lines.en: Dry kelp hangs along my spine.
I stroll through the woods, unhurried.
My snout puffs out a salty breath.
My horn sweeps the low branches.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩断枯枝，声音很响
lines.en: My hooves snap dead branches loudly.
Sea-touched hooves crush the shrubs.
The wet on my hide never dries.
A heavy, plodding gait. No hurry.
The grass flattens into a furrow.
I round a leaning tree.
Now and then I stop and test the wind.
My plates grind against each other.
Tree shadows slide across my back.
I walk steadily, heavily.
Standing, all four legs locked.
Head down, sniffing the soil.
The plates on my back ease open and shut.
I scrub my horn against a trunk.
Salt water drips from my seams.
My eyes fix on one point.
A low sound sits in my throat.
Wind stirs the kelp on my back.
I shift my weight to my hind legs.
No bird dares land nearby.

lines.zh: 我好像一直在等着什么
lines.en: I seem to be waiting for something.
Old scars cross my shell.

lines.zh: 咸水从我的背甲上滴下来。
lines.en: Salt water drips from my back plates.
The sheen of water shifts once.
I turn my head and look at you.

lines.zh: 你比劫掠兽矮不了多少
lines.en: You're not much shorter than a ravager.
The seaborn mark is all over me.
I catch your scent.
My horn points your way.
I haven't given half a step.

lines.zh: 甲背上的海藻还在滴水
lines.en: Kelp drips from my plated back.
My gaze stays flat.
There's no one else in these woods.
I can smell the iron at your belt.
That landed in a seam.
I take half a step back, heavily.
The plates on my back shift out of line.
I don't roar. I breathe hard.
Salt water and blood drip together.
I'll remember you for that.
I turn square at you.
Thick hide, but the wound runs deep.
My stride has slowed.
I'll come again.
This smell is rare to me.
I dip my head to sniff.
Seaborn changes what you hunger for.
Flesh is more use than grass.
One bite and that's gone.
I come closer. Not to hurt you.
—Perhaps that's true.
Hold it higher. I can reach.
I snort a hot breath.
My horn nearly brushes your hand.
You hit my plated back and rebounded.
I yield nothing.
The plates rasp against each other.
Don't touch the kelp on my back.
I lower my head, horn toward you.
You got lucky with that.
Three steps back. Enough.
I'm not a light thing.
My pod-shell rings louder than yours.
One more bump and I'll move.

lines.zh: 海嗣化之后，这本能淡了
lines.en: The seaborn change dulled that instinct.
I give a short, guttural sound.
No kin of mine answers.
I'm alone in this forest.

lines.zh: 背上的海藻是旧日留下的
lines.en: The kelp on my back is a leftover.

lines.zh: 我用角在地上划了一道
lines.en: My horn scores a line in the ground.
That line is my boundary.
The rest, I don't dwell on.
Walking is already enough.
Walking on and on.
I lower my head and take it in my teeth.
I swallow it without chewing.
Too hard. It sticks between my teeth.
I press it down into the soil.
Not a mouthful for me.
I flip it up with my horn.
I sniff. Almost no smell.
It's got salt water on it.
Not worth it. I move on.
It's down. That's all.
I raise my head, nostrils flaring.
Twenty-seven blocks. That's plenty.
I square up to you, legs braced.
The dirt loosens under my hooves.
The plates on my neck rise.
No bellow. Just heavier breathing.
You crossed my line.

lines.zh: 我受过一次伤，就会还回去
lines.en: Hit me once and I give it back.
Trees won't stop me.
You're running deeper into the woods.
I follow the line you took.
My plated back smashes through the brush.
Not fast, but I don't stop.
Trees snap at my flank.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，我都听见了。
lines.en: I heard every twig you snapped.
You turn, and so do I.
Horn first. Then teeth.

lines.zh: 你退到悬崖边就麻烦了
lines.en: Reaching a cliff edge would be trouble.
I press in, step by step.
I don't give up this line.
My horn rams your armor.
One toss of my head flings you aside.
My hoof stamps down beside your foot.
My plates rake your arm.
The shove sends you into a trunk.
You blocked it, and your hands shake.

lines.zh: 十七点伤害，这还不算最深
lines.en: Seventeen points. That wasn't even deep.
My teeth come in from the side.
My pod-cracking horns hit your shield first.
Missed. My horn hit the tree.
Something cracks deep in the woods.
Out from behind the tree, into the sea foam.
My wet plated back throws back the light.
My hooves sink into soft leaf litter.
There's salt in the air.
I raise my head to get my bearings.
This place is too green.
I come from somewhere with tides.
The sea has marked me.
I take one slow step forward.

lines.zh: 劫掠兽的甲，被海水泡硬了。
lines.en: Seawater hardened my ravager plates.
All four legs shudder on landing.

lines.zh: 我在水里反倒更不自在
lines.en: Water makes me uneasy now.

lines.zh: 爆风掀动了我背上的甲
lines.en: The blast lifts the plates on my back.
Something lodges in a seam.
This force wanders loose inside me.
Hunger makes even my plates feel heavy.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，我弓了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I arch.
The ground vanishes; I drop.
